advisor.army.lost.t: We have heavy losses, my lord.

advisor.chain.recovered.1.t: The workshops are running again. The wheels turn.

advisor.food.empty.1.t: Hunger, sire! The peasants have nothing left to eat.

advisor.food.empty.2.t: The granary is empty! The people are starving.

advisor.food.none.t: The people are starving, my lord!

advisor.food.recovered.1.t: The granaries are filling again. The people can breathe easy.

advisor.food.variety.t: The people lack variety in their food.

advisor.hello.t: Welcome back, my lord. The castle awaits your orders.

advisor.idle.build.t: A strong wall costs stone, but saves blood.

advisor.idle.calm.t: All is quiet, my lord. Perhaps too quiet.

advisor.idle.market.t: The market pays well, if one knows how to use it.

advisor.iron.low.t: The iron will not last much longer.

advisor.pop.falling.t: The mood of the people is sinking.

advisor.pop.leaving.t: The first peasants are leaving the castle.

advisor.pop.rations.t: The scarce rations weigh on the mood.

advisor.pop.taxes.t: Your taxes weigh on the people.

advisor.wood.low.t: My lord, wood is running short.

archer.attack.3.t: The sky will darken with arrows!

archer.hold.2.t: From here we have every enemy in sight.

archer.move.4.t: We see better from the heights.

assassin.attack.3.t: For you it is too late.

baker.done.3.t: The scent drifts through the lanes.

baker.move.2.t: I only have to close the oven.

brewer.move.1.t: I will bring a cask soon.

brewer.work.3.t: A little sip does no harm.

brewer.work.4.t: This will be a strong beer.

crossbow.hold.2.t: Not one step further for them.

crossbow.hold.3.t: The string is drawn, we wait.

engineer.special.3.t: A few nails, and it runs.

engineer.wounded.2.t: Ouch, I still need these hands.

farmer.move.1.t: I will look at the field.

farmer.work.1.t: It will be a good year.

farmer.work.3.t: A sip of water, then on.

knight.hold.2.t: The horse stands calm, I keep watch.

knight.move.3.t: Out of my way, I am coming!

knight.wounded.3.t: I am shaken, but not beaten.

lord.special.1.t: House and people are entrusted to me.

mason.work.1.t: Stone by stone one builds a castle.

mercenary.attack.3.t: Attack, like the storm over the dunes!

mercenary.hold.1.t: We hold as long as the pay lasts.

mercenary.select.1.t: The pay is right, what is to be done?

mercenary.select.3.t: We are yours as long as the coins ring.

mercenary.select.4.t: By the dunes, I am listening.

miller.move.2.t: I come as soon as the stone stops.

monk.attack.2.t: A staff is a weapon too.

monk.move.2.t: At a brisk pace, my lord.

peasant.attack.3.t: Does that really have to be?

peasant.hold.3.t: It is safe enough here, is it not?

peasant.select.2.t: Yes, my lord, what is it?

siege.attack.4.t: The walls are shaking, soon they fall!

siege.move.2.t: Slow and steady, it is heavy.

siege.special.2.t: Careful, it will land any moment!

smith.move.1.t: Let me quickly put out the fire.

smith.move.2.t: I come when the iron is cold.

smith.work.3.t: This will be a good blade.

swordsman.wounded.2.t: I am bleeding, but I fight on.

woodcutter.move.1.t: I will take the axe along.

woodcutter.select.3.t: Wood does not grow at the market.

woodcutter.work.4.t: One more blow, then it topples.
